steps.description: Audit and update all Kollywood (language: 'TAMIL') games/components to ensure only Tamil movie data/hints are included.
steps.details: Identify all games/components invoked in KollywoodSection. Update game logic and data in: GuessPosterGame, MovieIQChallenge, WhoPlayedGame, FilmDetective, ActorComboFinder, FirstMovieEverSeen, and GuessDirector for Tamil language. Remove any direct or fallback references to Hollywood/English movies (including hardcoded quizzes or demo data) in Tamil mode.
steps.expected_changes: All static demo questions/data, queries, and results (especially in MovieIQChallenge, WhoPlayedGame, GuessDirector) in Kollywood games use only original Tamil movies and personalities; direct or fallback references to Hollywood, dubbed, or unrelated content are removed. TMDb queries in games for TAMIL strictly filter for Tamil ('ta') original-language movies only.

assumptions: Kollywood section is identified by language==='TAMIL' for all games/components
All game UI labels remain in English, but clues, answers, and movies will represent Tamil cinema only for Kollywood
TMDb API supports with_original_language='ta' for Tamil movie filtering
